# DOT-001 .NET Service Instructions

- Use stable C# selected by SDK.
- Enable nullable reference types.
- Enable implicit usings.
- Warnings as errors.
- Enable build-time code style enforcement.
- Use async APIs for I/O.
- Async methods use Async suffix unless framework constrained.
- Dispose resources deterministically.
- Await async disposal.
- Support cancellation.
- Support appropriate I/O timeouts.
- Retries must be bounded and safe.
- Modern C# features may be used when they improve clarity.
